name: Illinois Summer Research Symposium 2027
organizer: Graduate College, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
description: The Illinois Summer Research Symposium is the Graduate College's culminating poster and presentation event for over one hundred undergraduate summer scholars from programs including the REACH pathway to Carle Illinois College of Medicine, held each July. The 2027 date had not been published as of September 2026.
